user_visible_outcome: Pawpaw feels like entering, browsing, and authoring a joyful living family story: immediate, warm, surprising, calm, legible, and effortless on phone and desktop.

journey.goal: Enter Varada's world, enjoy memories without friction, and create or publish a memory through one calm guided flow
journey.entry_point: Family passphrase screen or Admin sign-in
journey.success_end_state: The visitor leaves with affection and the author sees the exact beautiful memory the family will receive

steps.interaction: Open the family entrance and sign in
steps.expected_behavior: The threshold feels personal and welcoming, validates locally, responds immediately, and carries the visitor into the archive without a dead pause

steps.interaction: Move through Home, First Days, Chapters, and a memory
steps.expected_behavior: Navigation, loading, image changes, scrolling, empty moments, and endings preserve orientation, momentum, warmth, and a sense of discovery

steps.interaction: Encounter a slow image, stale link, offline state, or application failure
steps.expected_behavior: The interface keeps its world intact, explains the moment plainly, offers a useful next action, and never exposes a framework-default screen

steps.interaction: Create or edit a memory in the author's studio
steps.expected_behavior: The author sees one meaningful decision at a time—write, add moments, choose mood, preview, share—while identifiers and revision machinery remain offscreen

steps.interaction: Save, preview, publish, recover, or return later
steps.expected_behavior: The current state is unmistakable, feedback appears where the action happened, work is preserved, and returning resumes the meaningful task

field_dependencies.child: date, author, recipient, and media prompts
field_dependencies.rule: Show only prompts that matter to the selected kind of memory
field_dependencies.on_parent_change: Preserve entered values but replace irrelevant required language with the correct guidance

field_dependencies.rule: Generate the address automatically for a new memory
field_dependencies.on_parent_change: Keep following the title until the author explicitly edits advanced address settings

field_dependencies.rule: Unlock later actions as soon as the first save creates the draft
field_dependencies.on_parent_change: Move directly into the next useful step and explain what became available

states.name: ready
states.expected_behavior: The primary next action is obvious and supporting controls stay quiet

states.name: loading
states.expected_behavior: Existing content remains stable where possible and a branded lightweight cue communicates progress

states.name: success
states.expected_behavior: A nearby concise confirmation says what happened and what is now possible

states.name: failure
states.expected_behavior: Plain language preserves dignity, protects entered work, and provides retry or a safe route back

states.name: empty
states.expected_behavior: The empty surface feels intentional and gives one welcoming next step

states.name: offline
states.expected_behavior: The archive remains visually Pawpaw, truthfully explains connectivity, and makes retry effortless

failure_recovery: Never replace a visible photograph with an unready blank frame; decode the next image before revealing it
Keep typed authoring content in component state after save or publish errors and focus the relevant message
Give not-found, application-error, and offline surfaces an immediate route back into the family journey
Treat authentication failure as recoverable human input, not as a security lecture or generic technical fault
journey.return_behavior: Back, refresh, and re-entry preserve understandable location; the author returns to the active studio step and the family returns to a recognizable story surface.
domain_expectations: Real photographs and real family language carry the emotional weight
Decorative characters support photographs without impersonating or obscuring Varada
Warm paper, editorial typography, bounded colour worlds, gentle motion, and small wit form one coherent archive
Private implementation remains invisible unless a visitor needs to understand a recovery action

non_negotiable_quality: The journey—not architecture, governance, or generic component consistency—is the final decision rule
Family and Admin surfaces are visually composed at 360, 390, 768, 1024, 1366, and 1440 pixel widths
No image navigation produces a blank selected frame and below-the-fold story images load progressively
No route exposes raw Next.js loading, error, or not-found output
The authoring studio removes technical vocabulary and avoids a single giant control wall
Reduced motion, keyboard use, readable contrast, explicit labels, and comfortable touch targets remain first-class
realistic_harms_prevented: Family members abandoning a slow or emotionally sterile archive
Blank imagery, disorienting waits, dead-end errors, and accidental loss of typed work
Authors avoiding memories because the studio exposes database-shaped complexity
Accidental publishing or deletion caused by ambiguous actions
Private family photographs or writing becoming public while removing unnecessary visible privacy friction

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Family login is personal, fast-feeling, responsive, locally validates empty input, and offers clear pending and recoverable failure feedback.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: playwright journey login checks at 390px and 1366px

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Home carousel retains the current photograph until the requested photograph decodes, preloads adjacent photographs, and remains keyboard, swipe, and reduced-motion usable.
Home, First Days, Chapters, and memory detail form a coherent editorial world with deliberate background, colour, typography, copy, scrolling rhythm, and a satisfying continuation or ending.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: desktop and mobile screenshot review of all family routes

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Loading, empty, offline, not-found, and application-error states are designed Pawpaw surfaces with truthful copy and an immediate useful action.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: playwright boundary and offline journey checks

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Admin login and the author's studio present one meaningful task at a time, keep technical identifiers advanced or automatic, and make the next action obvious on desktop and mobile.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: authenticated Admin screenshot and interaction review at 390px and 1366px

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Save, preview, publish, unpublish, upload, and failure feedback appears near the initiating action, preserves entered work, and uses plain family-facing language.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: focused Admin interaction tests plus authenticated preview review

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Letters are truthfully presented as publishable and Home no longer shows a hardcoded baby-age fact.
Type-check, lint, focused tests, full deterministic tests, production build, and scope gate complete without new dependencies, migrations, services, or paid cost.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build

architecture_allowances.justification: The current photograph must remain visible until the requested signed image has decoded

architecture_allowances.item: route-level loading, error, and not-found boundaries
architecture_allowances.justification: Visitors otherwise encounter dead waits and raw framework failure surfaces
The existing fourteen-thousand-pixel editor creates severe cognitive and interaction friction

protective_controls.risk: Typed family writing is lost after a recoverable save or publish failure
Existing immutable publication and explicit destructive confirmations must remain authoritative

coherence_axes.radius: Soft but editorial: small controls 10–14px, composed story surfaces 20–32px; no indiscriminate pill cards
coherence_axes.shadow: Warm, low-opacity depth used for photographs and focused surfaces only
coherence_axes.accent: Home coral, story violet, letter blue, gallery terracotta, moment green, with photo-derived ambient colour kept bounded
coherence_axes.spacing: Generous story rhythm and tight control grouping; density follows the emotional task
coherence_axes.typography: Fraunces for memory and wonder, Manrope for calm clarity, Malayalam script font when needed; readable measures and confident hierarchy
coherence_axes.control_states: Every actionable control has visible hover, focus, active, pending, success, error, and disabled treatment without layout jump

non_goals: No architecture modernization, database redesign, Docker repair, new CMS, design-system rewrite, or speculative scalability work
No new dependency, migration, service, analytics product, autoplay, AI-generated family copy, or production content mutation
No weakening of the private-media or active-family access boundary; only visible and workflow friction may be removed
No production merge or production deployment before owner review of the preview journey
simplest_acceptable_approach: Reshape the existing React and CSS surfaces, reuse the current actions and data model, add only the tiny UI state and route boundaries directly required by the experience, and verify the real journey before release.

behavioral: Exercise family entrance, nav, carousel, chapter scroll, stale route, retry, and Leave behavior
Exercise Admin sign-in failure/callback, create, edit, save, media, preview, publish, unpublish, and return behavior without mutating production content
Confirm keyboard, touch, reduced-motion, and local feedback behavior
perceptual: Compare mobile and desktop screenshots for entrance, Home, First Days, Chapters, memory detail, Admin dashboard, editor, media, loading, and failure surfaces
Inspect colour balance, type hierarchy, readable measure, scroll rhythm, character restraint, empty space, action priority, and emotional coherence
